reviews.title: Serious Revisions Required
reviews.text:
I appreciate the opportunity to complete this course, but I cannot recommend it in its current state. It falls well below the standard expected of an educational program that prepares students for driving and state testing. The course is outdated, poorly maintained, and insufficiently reviewed before being assigned to students.
The problems I encountered were numerous and consistent throughout the course. There were frequent spelling, grammar, and proofread errors, along with improper indentations and inconsistent formatting that made the material very unprofessional and equivalent to a sixth grade essay. Many of the videos were outdated, some of which dating to the mid-2000s, and one even ended by directing viewers to MySpace, which immediately made the course feel obsolete. In addition, the information was often inconsistent between lessons, and the wording of passages, questions, and answer choices was frequently unclear or awkwardly written, making it difficult to determine what was actually being asked.
The course also had several technical and usability issues. The timer was inaccurate, pages loaded slowly, completion percentages updated inconsistently, and resources were sometimes difficult to access or just completely unreliable. The interface was confusing and unnecessarily difficult to navigate, especially for first-time users, and the login process was more complicated than it needed to be. reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: The worst to deal with. Made me read pages upon pages of stuff purely about what to do when driving a motorcycle. A MOTORCYCLE. I was doing drivers ed for a car. They waste your time talking about outdated things, irrelevant things, and they just word everything in the most confusing way possible. This program isn’t succinct AT ALL and it truly feels like watching a microwave countdown while waiting for the page timer to run out. They’ll give you a 4 minute timer on a page with two paragraphs. They do it to make sure you get your required time, but it’s stupid because you’ll finish reading and be sitting there for the next two minutes just waiting around!! Get literally any other drivers ed program

reviews.title: Fix your app
reviews.text: This app is so stupid. It doesn’t work. I cant press any buttons and its making me loose my mind. If this is something people have to  not only pay for but also are required to complete to get their license there’s absolutely no reason there should’ve been this little effort put into making this app. There’s no way for me to complete anything because the buttons are either cut off my screen or just don’t work entirely. Not to mention i am a fast reader and have to wait so long for it to let me go to the next page, not everyone read 5 words per minute.

reviews.title: Won’t load my exam
reviews.text: I took the exam and with I am shown the “view your results” I attempted to click it and felt the feedback via vibration and nothing loaded for like 10 minutes of trying I exited the app and my progress was reset, took the exam again same issue, never using this again. DO NOT BUY THIS COURSE. On a side note the course was sloppily designed with missing spaces, spelling and grammar errors and generally poor user interface.
